question: What is the meaning of information related to disposal process in relation to end-of-life management?
description: The information related to the disposal process in relation to end-of-life management refers to the documentation on sorting, collecting, and treating objects during the end-of-life phase. This data is crucial for understanding how products are handled and managed once they reach the end of their life cycle, ensuring proper disposal methods are followed to minimize environmental impact and promote sustainability.
